about: The Missouri River bottoms area covers about 116 square miles of St. Charles County. It is made up of 7 smaller watersheds: Dubois Creek-Missouri River, Labadie Creek-Missouri River, Wildhorse Creek-Missouri River, Greens Chute-Missouri River, Duckett Creek-Missouri River, Cowmire Creek-Missouri River and Outlet Missouri River. Click one to open it. The land ranges from about 840 feet above sea level at its highest point to about 410 feet at its lowest. Its main streams are Bigelow Creek, Crow Creek, Fisher Creek and Duckett Creek. Communities here include West Alton, St. Charles, Weldon Spring, Augusta, St. Peters and Weldon Spring Heights. All of its water ends up in the Missouri River, which joins the Mississippi River at the east end of St. Charles County.
